messages.text: Urgent please live support
Handed to the team · Customer asked for a human right away

The team has it and someone will jump into this chat — stay here if you can, otherwise they'll confirm by email, usually within one business day.

Meanwhile, what's going on? I may be able to sort it right now.
Im waiting until live support is hete
Understood — they're on now and will pick this up here. I'll leave you to it.
How long does it approximitly take?
The team is on right now, so usually not long. If they can't get to it before the chat closes, they'll confirm by email, usually within one business day.
Im waiting here its urgent please

They've got it and they're in the inbox now. Stay on this chat.

If you tell me what it's about, I can start on it while you wait — worst case it saves them a round trip.
Im waiting since 1 day :(

Sorry you've been waiting a day — that's not good enough. It's flagged and in front of them now.

What's it about? If it's an existing order I can get it to the right person straight away.
I wanna order please
Read the bitfortun bs 4 page
Searched the catalog · Bitfortun BS-4 22TH miner

The B.4 isn't buyable right now — Bitfortun is off sale while they finish a firmware fix, so I can't put one in a cart.

What I'd point you at instead: the Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s, best value per terahash we sell. Ships Nov 21, 2026.

Want me to build that cart?
Please urgent live support otherwise i will not buy it
Handed to the team · Shopper insists on a live person before buying; BS-4 not purchasable
Georges has it and will pick it up right here — stay in the chat. If you step away he'll email you.
I go to sleep now
Used the chat-interview skill

Sleep well — Georges will email you so nothing's lost overnight.

Before you go, one thing: what made the BS-4 the one you wanted?
Please send today an answere to rudhardk
Noted — I've added that name to the flag so Georges knows who to write to. The team is on until 6pm Eastern, so there's a good chance it goes out today.
(email hidden) which data ids right.. 22th 300 watt or 18 and 300watt

The live listing is the right one: 18 TH/s at about 300 W. The 22 TH/s figure was an older listing that Bitfortun corrected — the hardware didn't reach it.

That correction is also why the unit is off sale at the moment.
But then its absolutly not efficient with even the new chips

You're right — 18 TH at 300 W is about 16.7 J/TH. Fair, not special.

The Harlo B30 is the better machine: 30 TH/s at 360–450 W, so roughly 12–15 J/TH, $899. One note for Germany: the price excludes 21% import VAT, charged on delivery.

Want the numbers for your power rate?
Thor p2 alot better
Read the hammer miner thor p2 page

Efficiency is basically the same: 166 W for 10 TH is ~16.6 J/TH, so no better than the BS-4. It is quieter (~40 dB) and cheaper to get in at $369. Ships October 3, 2026.

Where it loses is cost per terahash — $37/TH, against $30 on the B30 and $20 on the Magic Miner 40T.
But on your website its saying p2 has 13.6

The spec list on that listing says ~10 TH/s at ~166 W, which works out to 16.6 J/TH. I can't see a 13.6 anywhere in it, so I don't want to guess which figure is right.

Let me get that checked rather than talk around it.
Handed to the team · Conflicting efficiency figure for the Thor P2 on site

JD on our side will confirm the real number and it'll come to you at that address.

If 13.6 J/TH turns out right, the P2 becomes the efficiency pick. At 16.6 it doesn't.
Sorry i ment thor p3 and bsb
Read the hammer miner glod p3 page

That fits the BSB B30 — 30 TH/s at around 410 W is 13.6 J/TH. So the B30 is the efficient one of the pair, not the P2.

The G. P3 I can't sell you: it's cancelled, no date, so leave it out of the comparison.

B30 is $899, ships November 30, 2026. Want me to build that cart?
